match = re.search(r'(January|February|March|April|May|June|July|August|September|October|November|December)\s+(\d{1,2}),\s+(\d{4})', date_str)

    raise ValueError('Could not parse date string')

orders_sorted = sorted(orders, key=lambda o: o['created_at'], reverse=True)
last_two = orders_sorted[:2]
amazon_order_ids = [o['order_id'] for o in last_two]
amazon_paid_amounts = [float(o['paid_amount']) for o in last_two]
amazon_total = round(sum(amazon_paid_amounts), 2)

print('paid_amounts:', amazon_paid_amounts, 'amazon_total:', amazon_total)

# Current date
cur = apis.phone.get_current_date_and_time()
import re
month_map = {m:i for i,m in enumerate(['January','February','March','April','May','June','July','August','September','October','November','December'], start=1)}
match=re.search(r'(January|February|March|April|May|June|July|August|September|October|November|December)\s+(\d{1,2}),\s+(\d{4})', cur['date'])
month_name, day, year = match.group(1), int(match.group(2)), int(match.group(3))
cur_date = f"{year:04d}-{month_map[month_name]:02d}-{day:02d}"
print('cur_date:', cur_date)

# Venmo login
pw = {p['account_name']: p['password'] for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()}
venmo_access = apis.venmo.login(username='normansmit@gmail.com', password=pw['venmo'])['access_token']

brenda_email = 'brenda.webe@gmail.com'

# Fetch Venmo received tx from Brenda today (full pagination)
all_tx=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    resp = apis.venmo.show_transactions(access_token=venmo_access, user_email=brenda_email, direction='received', min_created_at=cur_date, max_created_at=cur_date, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit, sort_by='-created_at')
    print('venmo tx page', page_index, 'count', len(resp) if resp else 0)
    if not resp:
        break
    all_tx.extend(resp)
    page_index += 1

# Filter amazon-related by description containing 'Amazon' (case-insensitive)
amazon_related=[]
for t in all_tx:
    desc = (t.get('description') or '')
    if 'amazon' in desc.lower():
        amazon_related.append(t)

venmo_amazon_amounts = [float(t['amount']) for t in amazon_related]
venmo_amazon_total = round(sum(venmo_amazon_amounts), 2)
print('amazon_related_tx_ids:', [t['transaction_id'] for t in amazon_related])
print('venmo_amazon_amounts:', venmo_amazon_amounts, 'venmo_amazon_total:', venmo_amazon_total)

# Determine correction: if venmo_amazon_total > amazon_total, send back difference to Brenda; if less, request/pull difference from Brenda
if venmo_amazon_total > amazon_total:
    correction_type = 'send'
    correction_amount = round(venmo_amazon_total - amazon_total, 2)
    receiver_email = brenda_email
elif venmo_amazon_total < amazon_total:
    correction_type = 'request'
    correction_amount = round(amazon_total - venmo_amazon_total, 2)
    receiver_email = brenda_email
else:
    correction_type = 'none'
    correction_amount = 0.0
    receiver_email = None

for t in amazon_related:
    print('  tx_id', t['transaction_id'], '| amount', float(t['amount']), '| created_at', t['created_at'], '| description', t.get('description'))
print('Totals: amazon_total', amazon_total, '| venmo_amazon_total', venmo_amazon_total, '| diff(venmo-amazon)', round(venmo_amazon_total-amazon_total,2))

# Prepare payload
note = 'Fixing amazon order payment.'

payload = {
    'type': correction_type,
    'amount': correction_amount,
    'receiver_email': receiver_email,

}
